provider_reference_policy.cost_control: Use exactly one user-product image and one sanitized control board. Never submit the finished scene reference or split table, chair, brownie, spoon or lighting into extra provider inputs.

transfer_scope: broad topology only: a newly constructed partial round table on the right and a newly constructed cane-chair family at upper-left
isolated dark warm-brown directional wood material family without exact grain pixels
isolated natural cane-webbing and bentwood material family without exact chair geometry
original-reference double-green-rim plate, dark rectangular moist brownie, generous melting white cream, uneven cocoa dust and approved reclaimed-wood teaspoon identity and relative arrangement
upper-left key direction, broad partial product-crossing environmental shadow and elongated lower-right cast-shadow behavior
empty product-zone relationship only; never render the board's empty ring

container_transfer_by_mode.reconstruct_source: The board contains no source cup. Reconstruct the user's broad cup family, material, handle state and visible source serviceware.
container_transfer_by_mode.adopt_reference: Use the preset's declared plain unbranded warm-white matte paper-cup design; the board supplies no cup design or beverage.

preserve: broad source container family and material
visible source saucer, support plate and spoon
reconstruct_source.wood_integration: rebuild local reflection, refraction, warm bounce, attached contact occlusion and cast shadow according to material; never paste source pixels with a halo
reconstruct_source.beverage_color_integration: the source image remains authoritative for ingredient identity and internal hue, luminance and saturation relationships; adapt only scene-relative brightness, saturation, reflected fill, transmitted light and boundary contrast so every beverage shares the surrounding table, floor and shadow field without washing out, neon-brightening, glowing or becoming visually detached
reconstruct_source.pale_neutral_component_adaptation: for every source-derived pale low-chroma beverage region, preserve its relative hierarchy while applying the scene's slightly underexposed warm-neutral diffuse pale-material response; it must read as white by contrast without exact pixel copying, pure-white clipping, brown contamination, flat grayness or a luminous cutout boundary

preserve: ice, foam, cream, fruit and garnish
adopt_reference.wood_integration: use warm reflected fill and attached shadow on paper while prohibiting wood grain or beverage color on the opaque exterior

product_wood_integration_contract.contact_occlusion: compact dense attachment directly beneath the vessel or preserved serviceware
product_wood_integration_contract.cast_shadow: one height-dependent elongated lower-right shadow attached to the product under the same upper-left window sun
product_wood_integration_contract.local_edge_response: keep the top plane and rim slightly more resolved; reduce lower-sidewall edge contrast and micro-acuity gradually, add a thin wood-colored environment wrap and prohibit any bright or dark cutout contour
product_wood_integration_contract.opaque_container: subtle warm-brown reflected fill only on shadow-facing lower edge; prohibit wood pattern, beverage stain or transparency
product_wood_integration_contract.transparent_container: preserve beverage identity while locally bending and darkening visible wood grain through clear lower sidewalls; restrict transmitted lift to the key-side rim, ice edges and a small lower-glass accent; merge the base into compact dense contact occlusion

Keep one complete primary beverage 0.20-0.27 of frame width and 0.17-0.24 of frame height, centered around x=0.61-0.70 and y=0.64-0.73. Recompose the same diagonal cane-chair, round-table, beverage, brownie and teaspoon relationships with 0.22-0.31 pale environmental negative space and preserve the complete product and declared companion group.

hard_fail: product looks pasted on, haloed, floating or sharper than the scene
light or shadow direction conflicts with upper-left window sun
product, plate or spoon shadow is detached or unnaturally short
wood grain leaks onto an opaque cup or beverage color stains its exterior
transparent container loses source beverage identity or ignores local refraction
beverage becomes washed out, gray, fluorescent, globally over-bright, glowing or visually detached from the shared table-and-shadow light field
source-derived pale low-chroma region is pure clipped white, brown-contaminated, flat gray or separated by a luminous hard boundary
round table edge, cane chair or pale environmental depth disappears
brownie, double-rim plate or wooden teaspoon is missing or replaced
reconstruct-source primary cup exceeds 0.21 of final width, has an oblique elliptical opening or exposes excessive sidewall
teaspoon bowl points upward instead of downward
cookie, plastic packaging, undeclared prop, logo or text appears
